param([switch]$DryRun)
$Adb = 'C:\Users\hzq00\Downloads\platform-tools-latest-windows\platform-tools\adb.exe'
$Serial = 'AVNS023705001888'
$UserId = '0'
$Packages = @(
    'com.eg.android.AlipayGphone',
    'com.coolapk.market',
    'com.twitter.android',
    'com.bilibili.app.in'
)
foreach ($Package in $Packages) {
    $OpsArgs = @('-s',$Serial,'shell','cmd','appops','set','--user',$UserId,$Package,'RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND','default')
    $WhiteArgs = @('-s',$Serial,'shell','dumpsys','deviceidle','whitelist',"+$Package")
    if ($DryRun) {
        Write-Host "$Adb $($OpsArgs -join ' ')"
        Write-Host "$Adb $($WhiteArgs -join ' ')"

        & $Adb @OpsArgs

        & $Adb @WhiteArgs
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Warning "Whitelist rollback failed: $Package" }
    }

#!/system/bin/sh
ADB_SERIAL='AVNS023705001888'
TARGET_USER='0'
for PACKAGE in \
  com.eg.android.AlipayGphone \
  com.coolapk.market \
  com.twitter.android \
  com.bilibili.app.in
do
  adb -s "$ADB_SERIAL" shell cmd appops set --user "$TARGET_USER" "$PACKAGE" RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND default
  adb -s "$ADB_SERIAL" shell dumpsys deviceidle whitelist +"$PACKAGE"
done
